and.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eventconf_sources WHERE name = 'opennms.internal.events'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eventconf_events WHERE uei = 'uei.opennms.org/availability/categoryBelowWarningThreshold'

changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO eventconf_events (id, source_id, event_order, uei, event_label, description, enabled, xml_content, created_time, last_modified, modified_by, severity) VALUES (Nextval('eventconf_events_id_seq'), (SELECT id FROM eventconf_sources WHERE name = 'opennms.internal.events'), (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(event_order), 0) + 1 FROM eventconf_events WHERE source_id = (SELECT id FROM eventconf_sources WHERE name = 'opennms.internal.events')), 'uei.opennms.org/availability/categoryBelowWarningThreshold', 'OpenNMS-defined availability event: categoryBelowWarningThreshold', '

Availability of category %parm[label]% dropped to %parm[availability]%%, below its warning threshold of %parm[warningThreshold]%%.

', TRUE, ' uei.opennms.org/availability/categoryBelowWarningThreshold OpenNMS-defined availability event: categoryBelowWarningThreshold <p>Availability of category %parm[label]% dropped to %parm[availability]%%, below its warning threshold of %parm[warningThreshold]%%.</p> <p>%parm[servicesDown]% of %parm[serviceCount]% services on %parm[nodeCount]% nodes are down. Window: %parm[windowStart]% to %parm[windowEnd]%.</p> Availability of category %parm[label]% is %parm[availability]%%, below the warning threshold of %parm[warningThreshold]%%. Warning ', Current_timestamp, Current_timestamp, 'system-migration', 'Warning');
